title: Strengthen S3 expired-budget controls with exact prepared Begin and causal hold assertions
outcome: The two expired-budget phase controls discriminate budget exhaustion from unrelated holds and verify retained prepared Begin identity.
acceptance: The real-writer 35-second control captures the prepared Begin at its barrier and compares retained key, grant, delivery range/tokens and expiry basis after the ambiguous outcome, accounting for intentional phase-only transitions.

Both 35-second controls assert the actual causal hold reason and no provider handoff; healthy 15-second twins remain passing. A discriminating mutation of retained Begin identity or wrong withholding reason makes the corresponding control fail.
Reuse the existing phase harness/writer/clock and retain bounded sanitized reports, unchanged production budget/TTL/authority behavior, and the original review/run provenance.
